title: Cyber Security Operations Analyst
jobDescription: About The Position The Senior Security Operations Analyst will be responsible for monitoring security alerts, investigating incidents, managing security events, and ensuring timely resolution of security tickets. The role requires strong analytical skills, hands-on security operations experience, and the ability to work independently within established processes and SLAs.

title: Senior .Net Developer
jobDescription: About The Position We are looking for a Software Developer with strong expertise in C# and .NET Core and experience building cloud-native, distributed systems. This role involves designing and developing scalable backend services, microservices, and Kubernetes-based infrastructure while contributing to highly available, secure, and event-driven platform solutions. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise-grade applications, deployment automation, and cloud-native services.

title: Delphi Developer
jobDescription: About The Position We are looking for a Software Developer with deep expertise in Delphi and a strong interest in C# and the .NET ecosystem. This role is critical in maintaining and enhancing our existing Delphi-based systems while contributing to the phased migration of our platform to modern C# technologies

title: Security Engineer
jobDescription: About The Position The Security Engineer is responsible for building, maintaining, and improving defensive security measures, tools, and processes that protect systems, applications, and data. This role works closely with the Security, DevOps, and Engineering teams to proactively identify risks, remediate vulnerabilities, and strengthen the overall security posture of the organization.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer
jobDescription: About The Position We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Engineer to join our security operations team. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in AWS, Linux, vulnerability management, and penetration testing, along with hands-on experience using tools such as SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender, Azure Sentinel, and Cobalt. The role involves proactive monitoring, vulnerability remediation, and ensuring the overall security and stability of the infrastructure.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription: About The Position We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Product Manager to join our Product Management team, leading the evolution of our data-driven HTML graphics solutions. You will define the vision and roadmap, ensuring we enable productivity, performance and creative flexibility, for customers across our markets. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on driving product strategy and influencing the market, with a proven ability to move quickly to capture opportunity and influence cross-functional teams along the journey. You will be at the forefront of driving product development for software first solutions, upholding high quality standards without letting perfection delay progress - balancing excellence with speed to market. With an entrepreneurial mindset you will excel at collaborating with, and influencing stakeholders across the business, industry and markets we operation in.

title: C++ Developer
jobDescription: About The Position You will be at the forefront in shaping the future of our Sports broadcast, whose impact is seen by audiences around the globe. You'll be contributing and help shaping the entire software development lifecycle-from planning and designing user experiences to implementation, testing, documentation, and ongoing maintenance. Our technology stack is diverse, offering you the opportunity to work with tools and languages such as C++, CUDA, C#, .NET, Python, PyTorch, TensorRT, and Vue.js.

title: Azure Specialist
jobDescription: About The Position We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Azure Cloud Architect to design, implement, and manage our cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Azure services, cloud architecture best practices, and a strong understanding of business requirements. You will be responsible for translating business needs into scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud solutions.

title: Media Business Analysis
jobDescription: About The Position You will be BA for Media domain who will be SPOC between Clients & technical teams. You will help in Product designing & its implementation & demonstrate expertise of Media domain.
